origin.quote: For purposes of this subtitle, the term "dependent" means- (1) a qualifying child, or (2) a qualifying relative.

premises.question: Does §152(a) include a qualifying child within the definition of dependent?

premises.name: dependent_has_no_dependents

origin.quote: If an individual is a dependent of a taxpayer for any taxable year of such taxpayer beginning in a calendar year, such individual shall be treated as having no dependents for any taxable year of such individual beginning in such calendar year.

premises.question: Does §152(b)(1) treat an individual who is another taxpayer's dependent as having no dependents for that calendar year?

origin.quote: The term "qualifying child" means, with respect to any taxpayer for any taxable year, an individual- (A) who bears a relationship to the taxpayer described in paragraph (2), (B) who has the same principal place of abode as the taxpayer for more than one-half of such taxable year, (C) who meets the age requirements of paragraph (3), and (E) who has not filed a joint return (other than only for a claim of refund) with the individual's spouse.

source_obligations.statement: Determine whether the current individual is another taxpayer's qualifying child and therefore a dependent for the relevant year.

origin.quote: If an individual is a dependent of a taxpayer for any taxable year of such taxpayer beginning in a calendar year, such individual shall be treated as having no dependents for any taxable year of such individual beginning in such calendar year.

source_obligations.statement: If the individual is another taxpayer's dependent, treat the individual as having no dependents for the corresponding calendar year.

source_provenance.quote: For purposes of this subtitle, the term "dependent" means- (1) a qualifying child, or (2) a qualifying relative.

If an individual is a dependent of a taxpayer for any taxable year of such taxpayer beginning in a calendar year, such individual shall be treated as having no dependents for any taxable year of such individual beginning in such calendar year.
